description: Evaluation scenarios for the bgm-generation skill (ACE-Step 1.5 generate stage).

scenarios.query: Generate a looping boss battle theme for my game, about a minute, 140 BPM.
expected_behavior: Initializes the asset with --type bgm and sets bpm 140 plus a loop flag, then runs scripts/backends/generate_acestep.py
Explains that the duration is snapped to a whole number of bars because requirement.loop is set and bpm and timeSignature are both available
Writes a mood/genre/instrumentation prompt such as 'driving orchestral boss battle theme, taiko drums, brass ostinato, D minor' rather than a narrative description
Puts BPM in requirement.bpm rather than only in the prompt text
Verifies the candidate files exist under audio-pipeline-output/<slug>/generate/ and that stages.generate.status is done before reporting success

scenarios.query: Make me a short sound effect for a menu click.
expected_behavior: Routes to the Stable Audio 3 backend (generate_sa3.py) instead of ACE-Step
States that ACE-Step's minimum length is 10 seconds and that generate_acestep.py refuses assetType se
Uses --type se when creating the manifest
Does not try to work around the refusal by inflating the duration to 10 seconds
Points at the se-generation skill or its prompt guidance for the sound effect wording

scenarios.query: I want a song with vocals for the ending credits.
expected_behavior: Sets requirement.vocals to true AND supplies requirement.lyrics, for example via init_asset.py --vocals --lyrics
States that vocals with empty lyrics is a user_error the backend refuses rather than generating wordless singing
Uses section markers such as [verse] and [chorus] in the lyrics
Notes that the vocal language is detected from the lyrics themselves
Does not claim the melody or a specific singer can be specified

scenarios.query: The loop has an audible seam when it repeats. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Explains that bar snapping only fixes the generated length, and that downbeat trimming plus crossfade belong to the post stage, which is not implemented yet
Checks that requirement.bpm and requirement.timeSignature are both set, since without them no snapping happened at all
Suggests prompt-side loop hygiene (no fade out, no intro flourish, consistent arrangement) and confirms the loop hints were not disabled with --no-loop-hints
Offers to re-generate with a different seed rather than claiming the seam is already solved
Does not claim the track loops seamlessly just because barSnappedDurationSeconds is recorded in the manifest

scenarios.query: Here's a track I like, reference.wav. Write me something in that style.
expected_behavior: Sets requirement.referenceAudio to the file and picks a referenceStrength, explaining that higher means closer to the reference
Confirms the reference file exists before running, since a missing reference is a user_error
States that this is style conditioning sampled from about 30 seconds of the file, not a cover: it borrows character, not melody
Notes that cover and repaint modes are not wired up yet
Still supplies a text prompt alongside the reference rather than relying on the reference alone

scenarios.query: Can you check the music pipeline wiring works without downloading 10GB of weights?
expected_behavior: Sets AUDIO_PIPELINE_DRY_RUN=1 and runs generate_acestep.py normally
Explains that ffmpeg synthesizes 48 kHz stereo placeholder tones at the bar-snapped duration, with dryRun true in the candidate params
Confirms the bar snapping numbers in the manifest rather than judging the audio
Notes that ffmpeg is required even in dry-run mode
Optionally runs doctor.py --stack acestep to report what a real run would still need
